hook.title: *One* servo, eight shell pieces. Here's the design.

scenes.title: 8 tendons, 1 *ring*
scenes.caption: a Bowden cable runs to the servo

caption:
The scan animation is the whole reason I'm building this.

Each of the 8 shell pieces is designed to ride a spring-loaded pin in the core. Eight tendons meet at a ring on the eye axis, and a Bowden cable runs to a servo in the base. The servo winds a spool and pulls the shell shut. Let go and the springs push it open.

180 mm closed, 200 mm open. Files are free, link in bio. The first print is next.

Fan project. Destiny and the Ghost belong to Bungie.
